title: Special Topics; The Plant Metabolome-Microbiome Connection
description: Plant microbiomes are dynamic microbial communities that are specific to the rhizosphere and phyllosphere. These microbial assemblages shift in response to plant biotic interactions and abiotic stresses and assist plants in nutrient acquisition, plant defense and stress tolerance. This special topics course will discuss recent advances in linking the plant metabolome to the microbiome and explore how plant metabolites impact microbe interactions, to better understand the relationship between microbiomes and their plant hosts.
